source_note: Source-grounded practice MCQs generated from text-bearing PDFs, DOCX and PPTX course files bundled in the repository. Image-only PDFs were skipped and no OCR was performed. Existing real questions were reused where available. Question-level topic tags are metadata; the current quiz UI does not filter by them yet.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Proteins are polymers of ______ acids linked together by what is called “ peptide bond”."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: Proteins are polymers of amino acids linked together by what is called “ peptide bond”. The missing term is 'amino'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Asparagine and Glutamine: They are ______ forms of aspartate and glutamate in which side chain COOH groups are amidated ."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: Asparagine and Glutamine: They are amide forms of aspartate and glutamate in which side chain COOH groups are amidated . The missing term is 'amide'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Hydrogenation and reactions of hydrogen halides and halogens with alkenes and alkynes are examples of ______ reactions."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Hydrogenation and reactions of hydrogen halides and halogens with alkenes and alkynes are examples of addition reactions. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "If a ______ salt is treated with an acid that is an oxidizing agent, a redox reaction occurs in which I2 is produced."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: If a halide salt is treated with an acid that is an oxidizing agent, a redox reaction occurs in which I2 is produced. The missing term is 'halide'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "______ numbers are shown above the formulas, and oxidizing and reducing agents are indicated: Equations for redox reactions can also be written as total ionic and net ionic equations."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: Oxidation numbers are shown above the formulas, and oxidizing and reducing agents are indicated: Equations for redox reactions can also be written as total ionic and net ionic equations. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Besides their ______ or ketone form, saccharides can also exist in a cyclic form."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Besides their aldehyde or ketone form, saccharides can also exist in a cyclic form. The missing term is 'aldehyde'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Rather, as is the case with Te, P, and some other elements, it is easier to prepare compound containing iodine, and then carry out a ______ reaction."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: Rather, as is the case with Te, P, and some other elements, it is easier to prepare compound containing iodine, and then carry out a hydrolysis reaction. The missing term is 'hydrolysis'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Perhaps the most remarkable chemical property of ______ is its relative inertness."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Perhaps the most remarkable chemical property of benzene is its relative inertness. The missing term is 'benzene'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "There are two isomers that result from this type of ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: There are two isomers that result from this type of isomerism. The missing term is 'isomerism'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Polymerization is an important ______ reaction of the alkenes."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Polymerization is an important addition reaction of the alkenes. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Polyamides are condensation polymers that contain amide ______ (CONH 2 ) and are usually prepared from reaction of a diamine and dicarboxylic acid."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 12_FINAL.pptx: Polyamides are condensation polymers that contain amide functional group (CONH 2 ) and are usually prepared from reaction of a diamine and dicarboxylic acid. The missing term is 'functional group'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Compounds formed by the linking of small numbers of amino acids are called peptides, and the amide bond linking the ______ monomers is called the peptide bond."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Compounds formed by the linking of small numbers of amino acids are called peptides, and the amide bond linking the amino acid monomers is called the peptide bond. The missing term is 'amino acid'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "An enzyme is a ______ that catalyzes a biological reaction."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: An enzyme is a protein that catalyzes a biological reaction. The missing term is 'protein'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "In ______ to the 238Pu-based heart pacemaker already mentioned, lightweight, 124 portable power packs that use radioactive isotopes as fuel have been developed for other uses."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: In addition to the 238Pu-based heart pacemaker already mentioned, lightweight, 124 portable power packs that use radioactive isotopes as fuel have been developed for other uses. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Chlorine can be prepared in a laboratory by the ______ of Cl - by means of a suitable oxidizing agent."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: Chlorine can be prepared in a laboratory by the oxidation of Cl - by means of a suitable oxidizing agent. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Upon exposure to air, polyunsaturated molecules—molecules with many C=C bonds—undergo ______ to yield unpleasant-tasting products (vegetable oil that has oxidized is said to be rancid)."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Upon exposure to air, polyunsaturated molecules—molecules with many C=C bonds—undergo oxidation to yield unpleasant-tasting products (vegetable oil that has oxidized is said to be rancid). The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "A polymer formed in this way is called a ______ polymer."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 12_FINAL.pptx: A polymer formed in this way is called a condensation polymer. The missing term is 'condensation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "“Neothyl,” or methyl propyl ______, CH 3 OCH 2 CH 2 CH 3 , is currently favored as an anesthetic because it is relatively free of side effects."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: “Neothyl,” or methyl propyl ether, CH 3 OCH 2 CH 2 CH 3 , is currently favored as an anesthetic because it is relatively free of side effects. The missing term is 'ether'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "X-ray analysis and ______ are also used for molecular weight determination."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: X-ray analysis and mass spectrometry are also used for molecular weight determination. The missing term is 'mass spectrometry'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Alkyl groups (R) are named by replacing the suffix –ane of the parent ______ with -yl."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Alkyl groups (R) are named by replacing the suffix –ane of the parent alkane with -yl. The missing term is 'alkane'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The terms “______” and “reduction” are now applied much more broadly."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: The terms “oxidation” and “reduction” are now applied much more broadly. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Ethanol containing methanol or other toxic substances is called denatured ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Ethanol containing methanol or other toxic substances is called denatured alcohol. The missing term is 'alcohol'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Other alkenes can be prepared by cracking the higher members of the ______ family."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Other alkenes can be prepared by cracking the higher members of the alkane family. The missing term is 'alkane'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Compounds that contain one or more ______ rings are called aromatic hydrocarbons."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Compounds that contain one or more benzene rings are called aromatic hydrocarbons. The missing term is 'benzene'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The ______ name of every member of the alkanes ends with the suffix-ane."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The IUPAC name of every member of the alkanes ends with the suffix-ane. The missing term is 'IUPAC'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The side chain (R) varies from one ______ to another leading to differences in the properties of alpha-amino acids."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: The side chain (R) varies from one amino acid to another leading to differences in the properties of alpha-amino acids. The missing term is 'amino acid'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "For example, an enzyme is a ______ that catalyses a biochemical reaction."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: For example, an enzyme is a protein that catalyses a biochemical reaction. The missing term is 'protein'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The many possible interactions between different amino acids in the polypeptide chain cause each ______ molecule to adopt a characteristic shape, usually depending on its environment."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The many possible interactions between different amino acids in the polypeptide chain cause each protein molecule to adopt a characteristic shape, usually depending on its environment. The missing term is 'protein'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Beryllium is then produced either by ______ of BeF2, or by electrolysis of BeCl2 fused with NaCl."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: Beryllium is then produced either by reduction of BeF2, or by electrolysis of BeCl2 fused with NaCl. The missing term is 'reduction'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Physical Properties of Alkanes There is alternation as one progresses from an unbranched ______ with an even number of carbon atoms to the next one with odd number of carbon atoms."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Physical Properties of Alkanes There is alternation as one progresses from an unbranched alkane with an even number of carbon atoms to the next one with odd number of carbon atoms. The missing term is 'alkane'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Trisaccharides: a ______ that contains three monosaccharides is called trisaccharide."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: Trisaccharides: a carbohydrate that contains three monosaccharides is called trisaccharide. The missing term is 'carbohydrate'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The ______ may be represented as CH 3 (CH 2 —CH 2 ) n CH 3 , where n is approximately 400."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The polymer may be represented as CH 3 (CH 2 —CH 2 ) n CH 3 , where n is approximately 400. The missing term is 'polymer'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Their abundances and masses, determined by ______, are listed in the following table."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: Their abundances and masses, determined by mass spectrometry, are listed in the following table. The missing term is 'mass spectrometry'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Like alkanes, the boiling points of a ______ of alkenes increase 20-30K per additional CH 2 group except for the very few homologues."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Like alkanes, the boiling points of a homologous series of alkenes increase 20-30K per additional CH 2 group except for the very few homologues. The missing term is 'homologous series'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Neoprene is a synthetic elastomer (an elastic ______) with properties quite similar to those of natural rubber."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Neoprene is a synthetic elastomer (an elastic polymer) with properties quite similar to those of natural rubber. The missing term is 'polymer'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "When the hydrogen atom(s) in NH 3 is replaced with R groups, it produces ______."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: When the hydrogen atom(s) in NH 3 is replaced with R groups, it produces amine. The missing term is 'amine'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Because the linear arrangement about the triple bond does not lead to geometric ______, the prefixes cisand transare not used."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Because the linear arrangement about the triple bond does not lead to geometric isomerism, the prefixes cisand transare not used. The missing term is 'isomerism'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "With decreasing electronegativity on moving down the group, the eleme nt disproportionates and gets a more positive ______ state more readily."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: With decreasing electronegativity on moving down the group, the eleme nt disproportionates and gets a more positive oxidation state more readily. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Polyesters (short for “polymeric esters”) are ______ polymers that are formed when dihydric alcohols react with dicarboxylic acids."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Polyesters (short for “polymeric esters”) are condensation polymers that are formed when dihydric alcohols react with dicarboxylic acids. The missing term is 'condensation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The stability of ______ is the result of electron delocalization."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The stability of benzene is the result of electron delocalization. The missing term is 'benzene'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Like alkanes, branching in an ______ also lowers the boiling point."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Like alkanes, branching in an alkene also lowers the boiling point. The missing term is 'alkene'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The order of these monomers is termed the primary structure of the ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The order of these monomers is termed the primary structure of the protein. The missing term is 'protein'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Monosaccharides with ______ group are called aldoses while those with ketone group are termed as ketoses."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: Monosaccharides with aldehyde group are called aldoses while those with ketone group are termed as ketoses. The missing term is 'aldehyde'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Note: Fructose is a ______ - containing monosaccharide that can exist in a cyclic form."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: Note: Fructose is a ketone - containing monosaccharide that can exist in a cyclic form. The missing term is 'ketone'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "In ______ to all wavelengths of visible light, sunlight also contains shorter wavelength (ultraviolet) radiation as well as longer wavelength (infrared) radiation."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: In addition to all wavelengths of visible light, sunlight also contains shorter wavelength (ultraviolet) radiation as well as longer wavelength (infrared) radiation. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "During the 20 th century, organic chemistry branched into sub-disciplines such as ______ chemistry, pharmacology, bioengineering, petro-chemistry, and numerous others."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: During the 20 th century, organic chemistry branched into sub-disciplines such as polymer chemistry, pharmacology, bioengineering, petro-chemistry, and numerous others. The missing term is 'polymer'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The simplest ______ is C 2H4, ethene , which is usually called by its common name, ethylene, in which both carbon atoms are sp2-hybridized and the double bond is made up of a sigma bond and a pi bond."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The simplest alkene is C 2H4, ethene , which is usually called by its common name, ethylene, in which both carbon atoms are sp2-hybridized and the double bond is made up of a sigma bond and a pi bond. The missing term is 'alkene'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Ethyne, CH ≡ CH, the simplest ______, was burnt in the miners’ lamps before electric lamps were developed."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Ethyne, CH ≡ CH, the simplest alkyne, was burnt in the miners’ lamps before electric lamps were developed. The missing term is 'alkyne'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "This rather disagreeable-smelling liquid is used as a starting material in the ______ industry and in the laboratory as a preservative for animal specimens."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: This rather disagreeable-smelling liquid is used as a starting material in the polymer industry and in the laboratory as a preservative for animal specimens. The missing term is 'polymer'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Naming Saturated Hydrocarbons The ______ naming system is based on the names of the unbranched hydrocarbons and their higher homologues."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Naming Saturated Hydrocarbons The IUPAC naming system is based on the names of the unbranched hydrocarbons and their higher homologues. The missing term is 'IUPAC'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "– It should have the maximum number of substituents of the suffix ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Module 2.pptx: – It should have the maximum number of substituents of the suffix functional group. The missing term is 'functional group'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "______ can be primary (1°), secondary (2°) or tertiary (3°) depending on how many R groups are connected with nitrogen."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Amine can be primary (1°), secondary (2°) or tertiary (3°) depending on how many R groups are connected with nitrogen. The missing term is 'amine'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "By suffix , it is meant that the parent ______ should have a suffix."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Module 2.pptx: By suffix , it is meant that the parent functional group should have a suffix. The missing term is 'functional group'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "If there are components in the centre of each face, in ______ to those at the corners of the cube, then the unit cell is face - centered cubic (fcc)."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: If there are components in the centre of each face, in addition to those at the corners of the cube, then the unit cell is face - centered cubic (fcc). The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Electron affinity involves the ______ of an electron to a neutral gaseous atom."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: Electron affinity involves the addition of an electron to a neutral gaseous atom. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The more readily a metal undergoes ______, the more active we say it is."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: The more readily a metal undergoes oxidation, the more active we say it is. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The steps are The ______ of a hydrogen halide to an unsymmetrical alkene such as propene is more complicated because two products are possible: In reality, however, only 2-bromopropane is formed."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The steps are The addition of a hydrogen halide to an unsymmetrical alkene such as propene is more complicated because two products are possible: In reality, however, only 2-bromopropane is formed. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Each ______ is commonly given a three-letter abbreviation."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Each amino acid is commonly given a three-letter abbreviation. The missing term is 'amino acid'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Differences in R groups lead to differences in the properties of the α-______ acids."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Differences in R groups lead to differences in the properties of the α-amino acids. The missing term is 'amino'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "______ Nomenclature of Alkanes • Straight-chain alkanes take the suffix " - ane " and are prefixed depending on the number of carbon atoms in the chain, following standard rules ."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Module 2.pptx: IUPAC Nomenclature of Alkanes • Straight-chain alkanes take the suffix " - ane " and are prefixed depending on the number of carbon atoms in the chain, following standard rules . The missing term is 'IUPAC'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Aldehydes, Ketones, Carboxylic Acids, and ______ derivatives The C=O group is referred to as the carbonyl group."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Aldehydes, Ketones, Carboxylic Acids, and Carboxylic Acid derivatives The C=O group is referred to as the carbonyl group. The missing term is 'carboxylic acid'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "the most important method nowadays is ______ in its various forms."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: the most important method nowadays is chromatography in its various forms. The missing term is 'chromatography'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Of all the physical methods used, infra-red ______ is probably the most widely applicable."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Of all the physical methods used, infra-red spectroscopy is probably the most widely applicable. The missing term is 'spectroscopy'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Amines Amines are organic bases that have the general formula R3N, in which one of the R groups must be an ______ group or an aromatic hydrocarbon group."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Amines Amines are organic bases that have the general formula R3N, in which one of the R groups must be an alkyl group or an aromatic hydrocarbon group. The missing term is 'alkyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "However, under certain conditions, alkanes can undergo the following reactions: Sulfonation reaction Combustion/______ leads to different products with KMnO 4 as oxidizing agent we get alcohol."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: However, under certain conditions, alkanes can undergo the following reactions: Sulfonation reaction Combustion/Oxidation leads to different products with KMnO 4 as oxidizing agent we get alcohol. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The reaction of the ______ with formaldehyde leads to primary alcohols, while that with aldehydes other than formaldehyde yields secondary alcohols and that with ketones gives tertiary alcohols."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: The reaction of the Grignard reagent with formaldehyde leads to primary alcohols, while that with aldehydes other than formaldehyde yields secondary alcohols and that with ketones gives tertiary alcohols. The missing term is 'Grignard reagent'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "______ = a giant molecule with heavy molecular weight, formed by the covalent linkages of thousands of small molecules called the monomers."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: Polymer = a giant molecule with heavy molecular weight, formed by the covalent linkages of thousands of small molecules called the monomers. The missing term is 'polymer'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "104 Another but less common industrial reaction is based on the ______ of HCl in which oxides of nitrogen function as a catalyst."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: 104 Another but less common industrial reaction is based on the oxidation of HCl in which oxides of nitrogen function as a catalyst. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The polymeric amides, polyamides, are an especially important class of ______ polymers."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The polymeric amides, polyamides, are an especially important class of condensation polymers. The missing term is 'condensation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "-Provides insight into the electronic structure of molecules like ______, where π-electrons are delocalized over the ring ."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 2.pptx: -Provides insight into the electronic structure of molecules like benzene, where π-electrons are delocalized over the ring . The missing term is 'benzene'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The reaction between H2 and Cl2 is a classic case of a ______ reaction."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: The reaction between H2 and Cl2 is a classic case of a free radical reaction. The missing term is 'free radical'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Each ______ consists of one or more polypeptide chains with a unique sequence of amino acids."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Each protein consists of one or more polypeptide chains with a unique sequence of amino acids. The missing term is 'protein'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Hydrocarbon Derivatives Alcohols, Ethers, Amines, Nitriles, ______ Halides These functional groups are considerably more polar due to the greater difference in electronegativities between the bonding atoms."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Hydrocarbon Derivatives Alcohols, Ethers, Amines, Nitriles, Alkyl Halides These functional groups are considerably more polar due to the greater difference in electronegativities between the bonding atoms. The missing term is 'alkyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Some have very foul odors because of substituents on the ______ ring."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Some have very foul odors because of substituents on the benzene ring. The missing term is 'benzene'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Some types of natural ______ polymers play crucial roles in living systems."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Some types of natural condensation polymers play crucial roles in living systems. The missing term is 'condensation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The compound is fused with metallic sodium, whereby nitrogen is converted into sodium cyanide, halogen into sodium ______ and sulphur into sodium sulphide."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The compound is fused with metallic sodium, whereby nitrogen is converted into sodium cyanide, halogen into sodium halide and sulphur into sodium sulphide. The missing term is 'halide'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Reduction is a decrease in ______ number and corresponds to a gain, or apparent gain, of electrons."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: Reduction is a decrease in oxidation number and corresponds to a gain, or apparent gain, of electrons. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The phenomenon in which a plane of polarized light is rotated by samples of either isomer is called ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The phenomenon in which a plane of polarized light is rotated by samples of either isomer is called optical activity. The missing term is 'optical activity'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "In contact with water, the XX’ molecules react according to the reaction The halogen having lower electronegativity is found as the hypohalous acid, because it is the atom that has +1 ______ state."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: In contact with water, the XX’ molecules react according to the reaction The halogen having lower electronegativity is found as the hypohalous acid, because it is the atom that has +1 oxidation state. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "If instead of an alkyl group, one hydroxyl (-OH) group is attached to the ______ group, a class of compounds known as carboxylic acids."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: If instead of an alkyl group, one hydroxyl (-OH) group is attached to the carbonyl group, a class of compounds known as carboxylic acids. The missing term is 'carbonyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "All protein molecules are made of amino acids, a special kind of ______ containing an amino group (-NH 2 ) and a carboxyl group (-COOH)."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: All protein molecules are made of amino acids, a special kind of carboxylic acid containing an amino group (-NH 2 ) and a carboxyl group (-COOH). The missing term is 'carboxylic acid'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "In most cases, the fl uorination of a nonmetal produces the fluoride of the nonmetal in its highest ______ state."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: In most cases, the fl uorination of a nonmetal produces the fluoride of the nonmetal in its highest oxidation state. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Some of the Synthetically Produced ______ Polymers: 1-Polyethylene: in the presence of appropriate catalysts (a mixture of trialkyls, e.g."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 12_FINAL.pptx: Some of the Synthetically Produced Addition Polymers: 1-Polyethylene: in the presence of appropriate catalysts (a mixture of trialkyls, e.g. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "That part of the science which deals with structure in three dimensions is called ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: That part of the science which deals with structure in three dimensions is called stereochemistry. The missing term is 'stereochemistry'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "This results in an increase in the ______ number of an element in that substance."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: This results in an increase in the oxidation number of an element in that substance. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "For such a ______ to be formed, each monomer must have two functional groups, one on each end."

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "______ group substituents attached to the longest chain are thought of as fragments of hydrocarbon molecules obtained by the removal of one hydrogen atom."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Alkyl group substituents attached to the longest chain are thought of as fragments of hydrocarbon molecules obtained by the removal of one hydrogen atom. The missing term is 'alkyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Examples are When an H atom is removed from a ______ molecule, C 6 H 6 , the resulting group, C 6 H 5 — or, is called “phenyl.” Sometimes we name mixed alkyl-aromatic hydrocarbons on that basis."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Examples are When an H atom is removed from a benzene molecule, C 6 H 6 , the resulting group, C 6 H 5 — or, is called “phenyl.” Sometimes we name mixed alkyl-aromatic hydrocarbons on that basis. The missing term is 'benzene'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The secondary structure of ______ is the arrangement in space of the polypeptide backbone, without reference to conformations of the side chain (R)."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: The secondary structure of protein is the arrangement in space of the polypeptide backbone, without reference to conformations of the side chain (R). The missing term is 'protein'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "According to the original definition, the following reactions involve ______ of the substance shown on the far left of each equation."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: According to the original definition, the following reactions involve oxidation of the substance shown on the far left of each equation. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "If the OH group is attached to a carbon atom that is joined to two other carbon atoms, it is a secondary ______, and the carbon atom to which it is attached is a secondary carbon atom."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: If the OH group is attached to a carbon atom that is joined to two other carbon atoms, it is a secondary alcohol, and the carbon atom to which it is attached is a secondary carbon atom. The missing term is 'alcohol'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "In a ketone, the carbon atom in the ______ group is bonded to two hydrocarbon groups."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: In a ketone, the carbon atom in the carbonyl group is bonded to two hydrocarbon groups. The missing term is 'carbonyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The longer the hydrophobic ______ chain in alcohols, the lower the solubility in water."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: The longer the hydrophobic alkane chain in alcohols, the lower the solubility in water. The missing term is 'alkane'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Numerous reactions are useful for producing the acids and salts containing the halogens in the +5 ______ state."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: Numerous reactions are useful for producing the acids and salts containing the halogens in the +5 oxidation state. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Formed through ______ Broken through hydrolysis However, when large number of amino acids linked to form a giant molecule, such molecules are referred to as proteins."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: Formed through condensation Broken through hydrolysis However, when large number of amino acids linked to form a giant molecule, such molecules are referred to as proteins. The missing term is 'condensation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "There are many examples of ______ polymers based on a wide variety of bifunctional molecules."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 12_FINAL.pptx: There are many examples of condensation polymers based on a wide variety of bifunctional molecules. The missing term is 'condensation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The simplest ______ group is phenyl group (C 6 H 5 - and is abbreviated as Ph."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: The simplest aryl group is phenyl group (C 6 H 5 - and is abbreviated as Ph. The missing term is 'aryl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "- Esters have an oxygen atom linking a ______ and an alkyl group."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 3.pptx: - Esters have an oxygen atom linking a carbonyl and an alkyl group. The missing term is 'carbonyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "• Qualitative and Quantitative Organic Chemistry • ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: • Qualitative and Quantitative Organic Chemistry • Stereochemistry. The missing term is 'stereochemistry'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Carboxylic Acids and Esters - Carboxylic acids contain a ______ group (-COOH)."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 3.pptx: Carboxylic Acids and Esters - Carboxylic acids contain a carboxyl group (-COOH). The missing term is 'carboxyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Starch occur naturally in most plants as a storage ______ for example in maize (corn), cassava, yam and cocoyam tuber, potatoes, rice, wheat barley and other cereals."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 122-1.pptx: Starch occur naturally in most plants as a storage carbohydrate for example in maize (corn), cassava, yam and cocoyam tuber, potatoes, rice, wheat barley and other cereals. The missing term is 'carbohydrate'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Other ______ reactions to the C=C bond involve the hydrogen halides and halogens in which X represents a halogen atom."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: Other addition reactions to the C=C bond involve the hydrogen halides and halogens in which X represents a halogen atom. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "During the formation of the ______ bond, a ring is also formed and carbon atom 1 becomes chiral."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: During the formation of the ether bond, a ring is also formed and carbon atom 1 becomes chiral. The missing term is 'ether'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "A peptide bond is formed by the ______ of a molecule of water between amino group of one amino acid and the carboxylic group of another."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 12_FINAL.pptx: A peptide bond is formed by the elimination of a molecule of water between amino group of one amino acid and the carboxylic group of another. The missing term is 'elimination'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Basic Principles of ______ Nomenclature - Naming alkanes, alkenes, and alkynes follows systematic rules."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 3.pptx: Basic Principles of IUPAC Nomenclature - Naming alkanes, alkenes, and alkynes follows systematic rules. The missing term is 'IUPAC'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "In the ______ system of nomenclature, they are named as alkanals e.g."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: In the IUPAC system of nomenclature, they are named as alkanals e.g. The missing term is 'IUPAC'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "So ______ and reduction always occur simultaneously, and to the same extent, in ordinary chemical reactions."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 121 NOTES.pdf: So oxidation and reduction always occur simultaneously, and to the same extent, in ordinary chemical reactions. The missing term is 'oxidation'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The chemistry of polymers is more complex if the starting units are asymmetric: Several geometric isomers can result from an ______ reaction of propenes."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: The chemistry of polymers is more complex if the starting units are asymmetric: Several geometric isomers can result from an addition reaction of propenes. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Teflon is a very useful ______ which does not react with concentrated acids and bases or with most of the oxidizing agents."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 12_FINAL.pptx: Teflon is a very useful polymer which does not react with concentrated acids and bases or with most of the oxidizing agents. The missing term is 'polymer'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Alkanes can be prepared from: (a) alkenes or a alkynes, (b) ______ halides, and (c) carboxylic acids."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Alkanes can be prepared from: (a) alkenes or a alkynes, (b) alkyl halides, and (c) carboxylic acids. The missing term is 'alkyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Course code: CHM 122 Course Title: Introductory Organic Chemistry Course Unit: (2 Units) Module 3: ______"
questions.explanation: From Share Homologous Series CHM 122 (module 3).pptx: Course code: CHM 122 Course Title: Introductory Organic Chemistry Course Unit: (2 Units) Module 3: Homologous Series The missing term is 'homologous series'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "SBR is an example of copolymer called styrene butadiene rubber which is formed by the ______ of butadiene to styrene in a 3:1 ratio."
questions.explanation: From Share MODULE 11 CHM 12_FINAL.pptx: SBR is an example of copolymer called styrene butadiene rubber which is formed by the addition of butadiene to styrene in a 3:1 ratio. The missing term is 'addition'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "The larger of the two ______ groups is chosen as the hydrocarbon chain."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: The larger of the two alkyl groups is chosen as the hydrocarbon chain. The missing term is 'alkyl'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "Acetone or Dimethyl ______ (or 2-propanone) is a nail polish remover."
questions.explanation: From CHM102 MODULE 5.pptx: Acetone or Dimethyl ketone (or 2-propanone) is a nail polish remover. The missing term is 'ketone'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "CH 3 CH 2 CH 2 OH CH 3 CHCH 3 propan-1-ol propan-2-ol OH (iii) Functional Group isomerism This is an isomerism between compounds in different ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: CH 3 CH 2 CH 2 OH CH 3 CHCH 3 propan-1-ol propan-2-ol OH (iii) Functional Group isomerism This is an isomerism between compounds in different homologous series. The missing term is 'homologous series'.

questions.text: Which term correctly completes this statement from the course notes? "It occurs when large alkyl groups are attached to the same functional groups as in alkanol, alkyhalides or ______."
questions.explanation: From Share CHM 122 Complete Note.pdf: It occurs when large alkyl groups are attached to the same functional groups as in alkanol, alkyhalides or ether. The missing term is 'ether'.
